note: Scored over ASSERTION channels only — reviewer findings, REFUTES verdicts and deterministic-lens findings for the panel; model-authored findings for the baseline. Restatements of the manuscript and the converger's prose are excluded: counting them would credit the panel for quoting a planted error, or for agreeing with it. Detection requires a finding to NAME the planted token, which under-credits a described-but-unquoted catch — read the numbers as a floor. The subject is held out of this corpus entirely, so neither arm had anything to withhold and no answer key existed for either. Token spend: panel 165334, baseline 36857 (22% of the panel's). The baseline hit its sampling ceiling before matching the panel, so this is NOT an equal-compute comparison — the baseline had less.
